name: Cartoon Shade
effectText: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) while a monster that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set is face-up on the field. You can only Special Summon "Cartoon Shade" once per turn this way. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 monster with 2000 ATK or DEF that cannot be Normal Summoned/Set from your Deck to your hand. If this card on the field is Tributed: You can target 1 card on the field, or target 2 if you control a monster with 2000 ATK or DEF; return them to the hand.
